result:
I added `GET /api/v1/items/stats`, but nothing has been run or tested, as you asked. That includes the new tests and Ruff/mypy.

It returns `{"count": n, "newest_title": str | null}`. A normal user gets numbers for their own items. A superuser gets numbers across all items. "Newest" is ordered by `created_at` descending, with `id` as a tiebreak so the result is deterministic.

- **Model:** `ItemStats` in `backend/app/models.py`.
- **CRUD:** `get_item_stats(*, session, owner_id=None)` in `backend/app/crud.py`. The docs say routes must not run queries themselves, so the queries live here. A `None` owner means all items.
- **Route:** `read_item_stats` in `backend/app/api/routes/items.py`. It is declared before `/{id}` so `stats` isn't parsed as a UUID.
- **Tests:** two in `backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`. One covers a normal user (empty, then two items), the other a superuser counting all items.

The frontend client is not regenerated. `docs/api.md` says to run `bash scripts/generate-client.sh` and commit the result, and `docs/architecture.md` says never to edit the client by hand. I left it alone because I didn't want to start the app. Run that script before merging.

I didn't update `notes/`, since this project has no `notes/index.md`.
